# Boot-to-boot modes by draft mechanism

*Generated by `analysis/boot_modes.py` from `results/probes.jsonl`. Do not edit by hand.*

Each row is repeated boots of one identical configuration. `spread` is max/min. A **split** is reported only when the largest gap between sorted boots is at least 3x the scatter within the resulting groups — a wide unimodal spread and two tight modes are indistinguishable in a standard deviation, and confusing them is the error F020 made.

## Reading this

A mechanism whose **default** arm splits while its acceptance (tau) does not is showing the F021 effect. A mechanism whose default arm does not split — with enough boots to have seen it — would place the effect on the draft model rather than on the engine's speculative path.

With few boots per row, 'no' means 'not demonstrated here', not 'absent'. The slow mode was observed in roughly one draw in three for DFlash, so a three-boot row has a material chance of missing it entirely.
